blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Have you ever tried scuba diving?
exercises.why: In Russian these relationships are expressed either by the preposition с (with) + instrumental or by the instrumental case without any preposition. a) С + instrumental: *Он говорит с командиром. Я иду туда с доктором. Я иду туда с картой. Она пьёт чай с молоком.* Notice also: *Я сижу рядом с учителем.* — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0). From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.  ·  «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.
